Libra and Scorpio compatibility

How Libra (Tula) and Scorpio (Vrishchik) are traditionally said to get on, and the reasons behind it.

At a glance

Elements
Air and Water
Modes
Cardinal (chara) and Fixed (sthira)
Ruling planets
Venus and Mars
Place in the zodiac
2/12 from each other
Graha Maitri (Guna Milan)
3 of 5 points
Bhakoot (Guna Milan)
0 of 7 points (Bhakoot dosha)
Sign-level view
Mixed

Libra horoscope · Scorpio horoscope

The elements: Air and Water

Libra is Air and Scorpio is Water: head meeting heart. Libra tends to think a feeling through, Scorpio tends to feel it first, and the tradition says this pair does best when each learns the other's way of talking about what matters.

Temperament

Libra is a cardinal sign that starts things, Scorpio a fixed sign that sees them through. The tradition sees a natural division of work in that, as long as Libra does not push for change faster than Scorpio is willing to move.

The ruling planets

Libra is ruled by Venus and Scorpio by Mars. In the natural friendship of the planets, Venus counts Mars as neutral, and Mars counts Venus as neutral. That gives this pair 3 of 5 points in Graha Maitri. Two neutral planets neither help nor hinder: the relationship is what the two people make of it.

Their place in the zodiac

Counted from Libra, Scorpio is the second sign; counted from Scorpio, Libra is the twelfth. In Bhakoot this is a 2/12 placement. That is a Bhakoot dosha and scores 0 of 7. The tradition takes it seriously in marriage matching, and it is one of the first things an astrologer will check in the full charts, where other factors can soften it.

What each brings

Libra is traditionally said to bring fairness, charm and a real wish for partnership to a relationship, and to need harmony, balance and decisions that are made together. Scorpio is said to bring intensity, devotion and deep loyalty, and to need trust, complete honesty and respect for their privacy. The pair does well when each gives what the other needs, rather than what they would want themselves.

What signs can and cannot tell you

Everything on this page is the traditional sign-level view. In Guna Milan, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot are read from the two Moon signs (rashi), which need birth times, and they are only two of the eight kootas: the others come from the nakshatras. Two people of the same pair of signs can have very different charts, so a real match is judged from both full birth charts.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Are Libra and Scorpio compatible?

At the level of signs the traditional reading is: mixed. Their Guna Milan points from the two sign-based kootas are 3 of 5 for Graha Maitri and 0 of 7 for Bhakoot. Signs are only a starting point; a full kundli matching of both birth charts is what decides.

Should I use my sun sign or my Moon sign here?

Guna Milan uses the Moon sign (rashi), which needs your birth time. The element and temperament notes are often read for the sun sign too, but the Graha Maitri and Bhakoot points only apply to the Moon signs.

Does it matter which partner is Libra and which is Scorpio?

Not for anything on this page: elements, temperament, Graha Maitri and Bhakoot read the same both ways. Some other kootas of Guna Milan, such as Varna and Vashya, do look at who is the bride and who is the groom.
